data.one_liner: On-device credit card scanning using native OCR and browser WebAssembly.
data.what_it_does: Scans payment cards using the camera to extract card numbers, expiry dates, and cardholder names. Recognition runs fully on-device via native platform OCR engines on iOS and Android, and PaddleOCR via WebAssembly on the web.
use_when: You need to scan credit or debit cards on iOS, Android, and the web
You require fully on-device card processing without sending images to a cloud service
avoid_when: Your web app operates under very strict memory limits on iOS Safari where WebAssembly assets are heavy
strengths: Works offline with no third-party camera plugin required
Supports multi-frame voting, Luhn checks, and OCR error correction
Provides both a ready-made full screen page and a customisable preview widget
weaknesses: Web platform requires downloading a large external engine asset folder (approx 33-38 MB) via CLI script
High memory overhead on iOS WebKit browsers
data.setup_notes: iOS requires adding NSCameraUsageDescription to Info.plist and targets iOS 15+. Web requires running a Dart installation command to fetch engine WebAssembly assets.
